shared_elements: single carved panel with figures placed in the upper portion and plainer surface below
rounded/tapering upright slab form as the field for the carving
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief profile figures set on an upright slab with the imagery concentrated in the upper zone, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. A shows a group of interacting human figures with raised arms accompanied by rows of small sign-like glyphs, while B shows a single quadrupedal animal with an arched body and angular legs and no human figures or signs at all; the depicted subjects and their relationships have essentially nothing specific in common.
